scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when odds were fetched

bookmakers.description: Array of bookmakers with their odds

odds_type.description: Which feed this market came from: PREMATCH (current and opening pre-match lines) or LIVE (in-play prices). Present on every market; a run with oddsType=both returns both for the same market.

has_live_betting.description: Whether this bookmaker takes in-play bets on this match: taken from the pre-match menu flag, and always true for a bookmaker that appears in the live odds menu. Identical across that bookmaker's markets. It describes the bookmaker, not the prices — see odds_type for which feed a market came from.

selection.description: Outcome selection: HOME, DRAW, AWAY, OVER, UNDER, YES, NO, HOME_OR_DRAW, AWAY_OR_DRAW, NO_DRAW, or NONE (next-goal markets, meaning no further goal)

previous_odds.description: The price immediately before the most recent change. Published on both feeds; null when the price has not moved since it opened.

change_direction.description: Direction of the most recent price move, UP or DOWN. Published on both feeds; null when the price has not moved since it opened.

handicap.description: Handicap/line value for spread and total markets

is_active.description: Whether this odd is currently active/tradeable

overview.title: Match Odds Overview
overview.description: Summary of matches and their bookmaker odds
